questions.question: What does @Profile("prod") on a bean class mean?
options: The bean is created only when the prod profile is active
The bean is created only when the app is not running
The bean is created after all others
The bean is never created
questions.explanation: Beans with a profile are registered only when a matching profile is switched on.

questions.question: Which value wins if spring.profiles.active is set in application.properties and also on the command line?
options: The properties file
The command line
Whichever appears first alphabetically
Spring activates neither
questions.explanation: A command-line argument has higher priority than the same key in a properties file.

questions.question: application.properties sets shop.name=CornerMart, and application-festival.properties sets shop.name=CornerMart Festival. The app runs with --spring.profiles.active=festival. What does getProperty("shop.name") return?
options: CornerMart
CornerMart Festival
null
Both values joined
questions.explanation: The file for the active profile is loaded on top of the main file and replaces the same key.

questions.question: BookingRunner asks for a SampleData bean, but SampleData is marked @Profile("!prod"). The app starts with the prod profile. What happens?
options: It works and SampleData is empty
Start-up fails because no SampleData bean exists in prod
Spring activates the dev profile automatically
SampleData is created anyway
questions.explanation: The bean is skipped in prod, so a required constructor parameter of that type cannot be satisfied; use ObjectProvider.

questions.question: A developer creates application-production.properties but starts the app with --spring.profiles.active=prod. The settings are ignored. Why?
options: Profile file names must be in capital letters
The profile name must match the file name, and prod is not production
Properties files are read only in tests
Spring only reads one properties file
questions.explanation: Spring reads application-{profile}.properties, so the profile name and the file suffix must be identical.
